direct_property_monitoring._note: Direct properties are valued quarterly via appraisal. LTV, rental yield, and vacancy are primary risk indicators.

stress_scenarios._note: Stress scenarios applied to direct property portfolio only. Listed REITs and FX hedges retain daily market-data treatment.
stress_scenarios._note_migrated: Property shocks by type, rental stress (+10pp vacancy, -50bps yield), rate shock (+200bps), the -25% LTV stress shock, and the 5% tenant-default capitalisation yield are migrated verbatim from existing notebook assumptions.

_note_mixed_treatment: This fund contains direct properties (quarterly appraisal), listed REITs (daily market data), FX hedges (daily), and cash. Current policy treats as single mixed fund.
